title: Large Solutions for Fractional Laplacian on Infinite Cylindrical Domains
summary: We investigate large solutions of linear and semi-linear equations involving the fractional Laplacian on domains that are becoming unbounded in some, but not all, directions. Solutions that blow up on the boundary of a domain are commonly called large solutions. For local operators, such behaviour arises only in the presence of lower-order nonlinear terms. However, for nonlocal operators, the existence of such solutions is more subtle.
